answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. Weight counts only when attestations bridge five independent clusters, with no single dune of attesters carrying more than a fifth of weight, and each attestation signed by a quill bound to one identity's tenure, never lent or copied. Ten heads behind one root collapse onto one dune, sharing just 20% weight while paying ten bonds — 50 times the honest cost per unit of weight. Means first, then reward.
